notes: -ffp-contract=off stops GCC from fusing a * b + c into an FMA (the default x86-64 baseline has none anyway).
Each row is packed into a reused stack array and written with fwrite to stdout, fully buffered by setvbuf with a 64 KiB buffer.
Digits are validated before strtoull, which alone would accept a sign or leading spaces.
gcc -std=c23 -O2, statically linked and stripped, running on a scratch image.
